toolkit.title: Gmail
toolkit.access: Doddy can list your recent emails (sender, subject, a short preview) and create drafts after you tap Create. Doddy never sends, deletes or labels email. Google's draft permission also allows sending; Doddy has no send tool.

tools.name: check_email
tools.title: Check my email
tools.blurb: Lists your newest emails: sender, subject and a short preview. Doddy doesn't open full messages.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.title: Draft an email
tools.blurb: Creates a draft in Gmail after you tap Create on the card. Doddy never sends it.

receipt.summary: Connected, but the access granted to Gmail is broader than Doddy needs, so Doddy won't use it. Disconnect and reconnect.
